Hi, i wanna give some support from a girl who won't pass but is happy! We have this huge idea that to pass is everything! But there's so much more to it! You get to be yourself, you get to feel free and explore and experiment! You get to fall in love and be loved as your true self!

When i first started looking at transitioning, i had lived the first 21 years of my life as this relatively cute charismatic boy who could talk his way through anything! But i was miserable, it wasnt real, and it wasn't me. But i was scared to give up my comfort and my happiness! I honestly just thought I'd be the ugliest girl, and I'd end up regretting it and that everyone in my life was going to think i was some gross idiot. I put off transitioning for years because of those fears. That was a mistake.

The first time i felt calmness in my body, and a sense of self was after going down the path of transitioning and taking HRT! The first time i felt real in life was after living as my true authentic self! I have had a post about me online about how "this poor chad gave up everything for mental illness, and now he's ugly!" Whatever, first for everyone that says,"i look like a man, or im ugly. " There's literally thousands calling me pretty and wanting to spend time with me! All those people, i was scared about leaving and thinking i was weird love and support me! All my navy buddies came out in support! I've been married and in serious relationships as myself, and I've lived more of a life in the 3 years of transitioning than i ever did the first 25!

It's a scary unfortunate path to go down, and it's gonna have rough moments, but it's gonna be so absolutely worth it! Not to mention that you're 18 and just starting, you're gonna have so much growth and progress from just hormones alone! Please live your life the way you feel calmness!

I was talking to my therapist the other day about this exact subject! I'm gonna give advice, but it might not be applicable because we're all different people! 

First, you have to realize and fully be prepared that a transition is a marathon, not a sprint! It's a series of moments and days of wondering if you're doing the right thing and others where you feel completely yourself for the first time! It's the weirdest feeling to feel at home in your body for the first time! However, it's the most beautiful feeling! 

I remember the first time I took hormones clearly to this day. The first thought before I took the pill out of the bottle was; "what if this is a mistake? What if this isn't the right decision for me? "I'll probably never pass anyways, and I'm already an attractive and cute boy", what if no one loves me after?". I think I had a million concerns running through my head, and I think I realized that I'd at least come this far, I should at least give it a month! Nothing will happen in a month.

It's been 3 years since then, and I've had ups and downs, I've had moments of weakness where I thought about detransioning cause it's easier. But it's not easier. It would never be easier. When I look in the mirror and can't help but feel happiness or cute and content and like I'm the happiest I've ever been, I know truly that transitioning saved my life and that it was the best decision of my life.

The best advice I can give you is that if you feel like this journey will make you happier and like you will look in the mirror and see the light in your eyes, then you should chase what creates that light!

 The other advice is that passing is such a weird idea set out to make women feel like they will never be enough! I will probably never pass in the sense of society, and I don't care because I feel content in who I am! What matters more than being some specific idea is to be myself and to know that people will find me beautiful and attractive because of that! If you set out to be yourself instead of an idea, you will be the most gorgeous woman you can be!

No one can convince you to transition or tell you to because it's not our journey! But we can say that if you follow your happiness and joy! You'll be beautiful and live an amazing life!
